query:
select p.id, p.number, p.created_at, e.full_name as employee_name, p.amount_tyiyn,
                  p.comment, a.name as "account_name?", p.reversal_of is not null as "reversal!",
                  u.full_name as user_name
           from payouts p
           join employees e on e.id = p.employee_id
           join users u on u.id = p.user_id
           left join cash_accounts a on a.id = p.account_id
           where p.branch_id = $1 and p.created_at >= $2 and p.created_at <= coalesce($3, now())
             and (a.id is null or not a.owner_only or $4)
           order by p.created_at, p.id
